qualityObjective.en:
This is the umbrella workflow that coordinates all envelope layers.
Ensure the complete exterior wall assembly is built in the correct sequence, with compatible approved materials, continuous control layers, correct drainage and ventilation paths, and proper integration at openings and interfaces.
A typical exterior wall may include:
interior finish → vapour control → framing → insulation → sheathing → air barrier → exterior insulation → drainage cavity → flashing → cladding/masonry
But the actual Hochelaga assembly must come from the approved project documents.
qualityObjective.fr: cela is le umbrella workflow cela coordinates all envelope layers. Ensure le complete mur extérieur assemblage is built dans le corriger séquence, avec compatible approuvé matériaux, continuous contrôler layers, corriger drainage et ventilation paths, et proper integration à openings et interfaces. A typical mur extérieur peut include: interior finish → vapour contrôler → cadrage → isolation → sheathing → pare-air → exterior isolation → drainage cavity → solin → revêtement extérieur/maçonnerie mais le réel Hochelaga assemblage doit come de le approuvé documents du projet.
